apa.description: APA uses 'and' in narrative (integral) citations and '&' in parenthetical (non-integral). Citum models this declaratively via !mode-dependent, which is an intentional improvement over citeproc-js's implicit behavior.

chicago-notes.description: Chicago notes now renders structured archival manuscript details from `archive-info` in note citations. citeproc-js does not surface the same repository tail, so the verification layer records this as an intentional divergence.

chicago-author-date-18th.description: CMOS 18 14.104 lists an authorless webpage under its site owner/sponsor (drawn from `publisher`) in citation context. Citum currently falls back to the title instead, pending a `publisher` substitute candidate (tracked in csl26-f3hx). Authored webpages and authorless-and-publisherless webpages are unaffected.
